loading_strategy.principle: Load the minimum. No single task should need more than two or three files.

critical_context.summary: Global psycopg.Cursor.fetchone monkeypatch rewrites the current user's role to the active role; fetchall is NOT patched, so list-shaped role checks disagree with single-row ones.
users.role is a comma-separated VARCHAR; available_roles[0] becomes session['role'] and decides the landing page. CSV order is load-bearing.
signed_reports lacks UNIQUE(username, reporting_month) though five code paths assume one row per coordinator-month.
enforce_password_change is a before_request hook that only checks must_change_password; it is NOT an auth guard. All 41 login/role checks are hand-copied inline.
Worklog attachments are served from /static/ with no session, ownership, or role check.
dashboard.html fetches /_session_check, which does not exist; the 404 is swallowed.
The Angular app keeps the Flask session cookie via a same-origin /api proxy. Do not migrate to JWT without reimplementing the monkeypatch semantics.
The submission window has three divergent server implementations that disagree; never recompute it client-side.
The theme toggle must write BOTH data-theme and data-bs-theme to <html> and persist to localStorage.theme.
chart.js is installed but ng2-charts is not; a decision is required before writing any chart code.
